proof_body:
by
  intro f c z R M n hR hf hM hz
  have hdf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball c R) := hf.differentiableOn
  have hs := Complex.hasSum_taylorSeries_on_ball hdf (mem_ball_iff_norm.mpr hz)
  have hρ : ‖z - c‖ / R < 1 := (div_lt_one hR).mpr hz
  have hb : ∀ k : ℕ, ‖((k.factorial : ℂ))⁻¹ • (z - c) ^ k • iteratedDeriv k f c‖ ≤ M * (‖z - c‖ / R) ^ k := by
    intro k
    have hc := Complex.norm_iteratedDeriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le k hR hf hM
    have hk : (0 : ℝ) < k.factorial := by positivity
    simp only [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_pow, Complex.norm_natCast]
    calc (k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ * (‖z - c‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedDeriv k f c‖) ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ * (‖z - c‖ ^ k * (k.factorial * M / R ^ k)) := by gcongr
      _ = M * (‖z - c‖ / R) ^ k := by rw [div_pow]; field_simp
  have := norm_sub_le_of_geometric_bound_of_hasSum hρ hb hs n
  rw [norm_sub_rev]
  simpa [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc] using this
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c z : ℂ) (R M : ℝ) (n : ℕ), 0 < R → DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball c R) → (∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere c R, ‖f w‖ ≤ M) → ‖z - c‖ < R → ‖f z - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((k.factorial : ℂ))⁻¹ * (z - c) ^ k * iteratedDeriv k f c‖ ≤ M * (‖z - c‖ / R) ^ n / (1 - ‖z - c‖ / R)
